newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds barely changed, trade light.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds barely changed, trade light.

text.p: UK meals and feeds sellers were barely changed on Thursday with only light trading reported.
High protein soymeal ex-mill was unchanged for old crop while new was one stg up.
In the east coast stores sellers were one stg higher.
Rapemeal sellers were around two stg down while most other sectors of the market were unchanged.
Only one trade was reported when spot high protein soymeal fetched 208.50 stg on the east coast, but brokers said there was not much volume behind the business.
